question: Will Amcha Yisrael win at least one Knesset seat in the October 27, 2026 election?
resolution_criteria: Yes if Amcha Yisrael clears the 3.25% threshold and wins at least one seat in the official results of the Central Elections Committee (or a consensus of credible reporting). No otherwise, or if results are not known by October 31, 2027. Same rules as the Polymarket market.
raise_if: More polls show it at 3.25% or higher in the final week

history.rationale: starting at market, will adjust. Note: 3 of the 6 latest seat polls (10/12 to 10/15) show it at 4 seats; the market is thin at about $5k traded.
